title: From vibe coding to context engineering
excerpt: How to go from informal AI-assisted “vibe coding” to structured context engineering — and turn quick prototypes into reliable, production-ready software.
content:
This technical session explored the transition from informal AI-assisted “vibe coding” to structured context engineering.

Participants learned how to provide AI systems with clear context, make intentional implementation decisions, and transform rapidly generated prototypes into reliable, production-ready applications suitable for professional software development environments.
